expectations.text: Commit message starts with 'chore(' or 'fix(' for dependencies/security
Commit message includes '!' for breaking change or BREAKING CHANGE footer
Includes BREAKING CHANGE footer if not using '!'
Commit body includes details about updated dependencies and security fixes
expectations.evidence: Commit body lists updated dependencies, security fix, removed endpoints, response format changes, performance improvements
Commit addresses dependency updates, security fixes, breaking changes, performance improvements, and issue reference
